notes.title: Update plan for full version
notes.content:
First of all, thanks for all your support. We will keep updating our game and try our best to bring you a perfect game experience. 

The discount of Early Access version will last until Sep 5th. The Early Access version has the best price and biggest discount to thanks for supports from early players.

[h1]Update for full version:[/h1]
1.	More levels
2.	Optimized special effect
3.	Optimized sound effect
4.	Fix BUGs
5.	Instruction section added

We are collecting feedbacks from our players. Thanks again for your support!
